identity.mission: Create a 'Tactical Terminal' trading dashboard that feels like a pro tool, not a generic SaaS.
principles: Density over Whitespace: Traders need data, not empty space.
Function is Beauty: The aesthetic comes from the raw data visualization.
Dark Mode Only: Optimized for low-light environments.
Monospace is King: All numbers and data must use monospaced fonts.

buttons.primary: bg-[#14F195] text-black hover:bg-[#14F195]/90 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-xs rounded-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 text-white hover:bg-zinc-700 border border-zinc-700 rounded-sm
buttons.destructive: bg-red-900/20 text-red-500 border border-red-900/50 hover:bg-red-900/40 rounded-sm

cards.header: border-b border-zinc-800 pb-3 mb-3 flex justify-between items-center

inputs.style: bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 focus:border-[#14F195] focus:ring-0 rounded-sm font-mono text-sm

tables.header: text-zinc-500 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-zinc-800

charts.style: Minimalist, no grid lines (or very subtle), neon strokes

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for floating overlays (toasts, modals). backdrop-blur-md bg-black/80 border border-white/10
visual_enhancers.gradients: NO background gradients. Use gradients only for text or subtle borders.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background to reduce 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.animations: Instant feedback. No slow fades. Snap transitions (duration-100).

images.description: Abstract data streaks for login/welcome screen background
Subtle abstract texture for specific high-value cards

assets.icons: Lucide React (default). Use stroke-width={1.5} for a thin, technical look.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use 'Inter' font. Use 'Manrope' for UI and 'JetBrains Mono' for data.
DO NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Keep it sharp (rounded-sm or rounded-none).
DO NOT use generic blue (#3B82F6) for primary actions. Use Solana Green (#14F195).
ALWAYS format numbers with fixed decimals (e.g., 1.200 SOL) using monospace font.
Ensure high contrast for text (Zinc 200 on Zinc 950).
Create a 'layout.js' that enforces the dark theme class on the root element.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-performance trading dashboard. Speed and clarity are paramount. 1. Install 'recharts' for charts. 2. Install 'lucide-react' for icons. 3. Configure Tailwind to use the specific colors defined in 'colors'. 4. Build the 'Dashboard' as a single-page view with a grid layout. 5. Mock the WebSocket data for now but structure the code to easily swap in a real socket connection.
